# Ripls documentation context map

> Auto-generated by scripts/gen_context_map.js from per-doc `context:` frontmatter.
> Do not edit by hand — run `npm run generate:context-map`.
> How the system works, the schema, and your obligations when changing a doc:
> docs/context_map.md   ·   CI gate: `npm run lint:context-map`
>
> ⚓ marks an always-loaded anchor for its lens. A doc with no `skills:` facet
> applies to all skills; otherwise only the listed ones.

- [impact_metrics/emissions_prevented.md](impact_metrics/emissions_prevented.md): Emissions Prevented methodology — CO2e avoided from manufacturing avoided plus waste reduced, using embodied carbon (material+weight or spend-based EEIO), material emission factors, prevented-purchase rates, and per-transaction-type formulas. — lens: domain · globs: server/impact_metrics/estimator/** · triggers: emissions-prevented, co2, carbon, embodied-carbon, emission-factor, waste-reduced, eeio, material-category
- [impact_metrics/money_saved.md](impact_metrics/money_saved.md): Money Saved methodology — dollars saved estimated as item replacement value times a prevented-purchase rate, with per-transaction-type formulas, a 30% relative stddev uncertainty model, and user-facing explanation copy. — lens: domain · globs: server/impact_metrics/estimator/** · triggers: money-saved, cost-savings, prevented-purchase-rate, value-usd, replacement-value
- [impact_metrics/quality_time.md](impact_metrics/quality_time.md): Quality Time methodology — a composite relational-value score (one QT minute approximates one minute of quality in-person contact) from seven weighted attributes (duration, modality, group size, tie strength, reciprocity, novelty, vulnerability), plus belon... — lens: domain · globs: server/impact_metrics/estimator/** · triggers: quality-time, social-connection, belonging, trust-credits, tie-strength, modality, reciprocity, vulnerability
- [impact_metrics/testing.md](impact_metrics/testing.md): Test strategy for the completion-time impact draft and per-attribute override flow — collapses the experience/request × metric × override × state permutation space into load-bearing invariants, assigning each to exactly one test layer. — lens: domain, testing · globs: server/impact_metrics/**, server/services/experience/**, server/services/request/**, app/lib/presentation/screens/impact_metrics/**, app/lib/presentation/widgets/impact/** · triggers: impact-testing, draft-override, provenance-stamping, invariant, equivalence-class, completion-impact
- [impact_metrics/time_saved.md](impact_metrics/time_saved.md): Time Saved methodology — minutes saved by sharing instead of shopping/researching/solo labor, computed from per-transaction-type default minutes (or an AI duration hint) times a multiplier, with config vs AI-hint uncertainty tiers. — lens: domain · globs: server/impact_metrics/estimator/** · triggers: time-saved, time-recovered, shopping-time, labor-time, duration-hint, ai-hint
- [provenance.md](provenance.md): Origin tracking for computed and AI-generated values — the Provenance record (source, version, reasoning), TrackedString/MaterialCategory/Estimate wrappers, version-based staleness via ShouldRefresh, and selective backfill across gear metadata and impact es... — lens: domain, server · globs: server/impact_metrics/**, server/services/gear/service.go · triggers: provenance, tracked-types, staleness, should-refresh, backfill, methodology-doc, estimation-method
